ratification.notes: Ratified as drafted: the operator adopted the issue 44 listening-protocol draft (comment 5752151406; One Billion Sounds arXiv:2104.12922 section 4.2/section 6 methodology per first-author direction) in issue 44 comment 5752723656 (2026-09-20). Ethics/retention box (AC6) adopted verbatim: 'raw responses retained privately by the operator, no public release of raw responses, anonymized aggregates only, amendment permitted before first collection'; amendable at any time before listening begins. No amendments were made before first collection, so the draft's candidate ladders and trial counts stand as the ratified starting values: selection.cases_per_operator=4 per draft sections 6-7 (the unratified example's 2 existed only to bound the example); 13 candidate ladders + 14 binary trials exactly as drafted; catch_trial_rate 0.2; MUSHRA 2 blocks of 7 items; pilot 2 listeners, main 6 listeners (min 3 non-author musicians); fixed-count stopping.

gain.db.note: Draft-comment candidates; negative sign = attenuation convention.

clip.round_step.note: Powers of two 2^-13 .. 2^-5; L5 doubles as the MUSHRA low-quality anchor.

clip.saturation_ceiling.note: Severity rises as the ceiling drops; the array position, not the numeric value, is the rank.

osc.tuning_shift.note: Listen-only evidence: coverage receipt records 96/96 cases without qualified pitch truth; no corpus case may back a pitch-property claim.

envelope.breakpoint_shift.note: L1 sits just above the qualified estimator resolution (0.02); listening floor and estimator floor meet here.

noise.seed_shift.note: Statistically plausible wrong noise stream: the canonical identity-vs-quality case.

gain.polarity.note: Single-point polarity flip; binary detectability trial, not a ladder.

norm.wrong_peak.note: Run only in the applicability cell where the matrix shows the fault effective.

norm.wrong_reciprocal.note: Run only in the applicability cell where the matrix shows the fault effective.

ethics.consent_text: Participation is blinded listening under the ratified issue 44 protocol (draft comment 5752151406; ratification comment 5752723656, 2026-09-20): 3AFC AX detectability trials with catch trials and a session anchor, MUSHRA-style impairment blocks, and an independent forced identity (same-patch) question. Raw responses are retained privately by the operator; no public release of raw responses; anonymized aggregates only; participation terms amendable at any time before first collection.
ethics.identity_handling: Anonymized listener codes only; raw responses retained privately by the operator; anonymized aggregates only (issue 44 comment 5752723656, 2026-09-20).
ethics.raw_response_retention: Raw responses retained privately by the operator; no public release of raw responses; amendment permitted before first collection (issue 44 comment 5752723656, 2026-09-20).
ethics.access_control: Raw-response access limited to the operator; no public release of raw responses (issue 44 comment 5752723656, 2026-09-20).
ethics.publication_policy: No public release of raw responses; anonymized aggregates only; amendment permitted before first collection (issue 44 comment 5752723656, 2026-09-20).
ethics.compensation: Not addressed by the ratified ethics default; no compensation is promised (issue 44 comment 5752723656, 2026-09-20); amendable at any time before first collection.
